title: helichrysum serotinum
intro: Helichrysum serotinum, commonly known as African Elf or Mountain Everlasting, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family Asteraceae. It is native to the mountainous regions of South Africa and is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and stress. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum serotinum include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The combination of these bioactive compounds provides the plant with its medicinal properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various health issues.
